title: 第449章 越战越强捏碎你的法宝第448章 你护不住他们三个
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
丹峰半山安静了一瞬。
刚才围攻曹立的三名八品长老，一个砸在下方石阶，一个被踩晕，一个被拍进坑里。
白尊站在半空，手掌还维持着出招的姿势，他居然没拦住，一个都没拦住。
曹立慢慢转身，看向白尊。“现在清净了。”
白尊身上的寒意猛地翻起。
雪花大道在他身后转得越来越快，周围霜层顺着碎石往外爬，几个丹峰弟子被冻得连退十几步。
白尊盯着曹立，声音都变了。“曹立！”
曹立甩了甩发麻的手。“喊什么，我知道到你了。”
白尊双手结印，九品天尊大圆满的气息彻底冲开，雪花大道上浮出第二层纹路。
陆沉舟在云层后面眉头一动。
圣主也看向下方。
下一刻，白尊整个人化成一道白影，朝曹立正面冲来。“我要亲手镇压你！”
白尊化成白影压来，雪花大道在身后转得极快，霜层顺着山道一路铺开。
曹立站在原地，抬手擦掉下巴上的血，咧嘴一笑。“谁镇压谁，还不一定呢。”
话音落下，他脚下金光炸开，人迎着白尊冲了上去。
砰！
两人正面撞在一起。
雪花大道往下切，七彩莲往上顶。
霜光和莲光一碰，丹峰半山的禁制齐齐亮起，几座丹房外壁直接裂开。那些炼丹弟子抱着丹炉往后跑。
曹立拳头砸在白尊掌心，整个人往后滑出数丈，白尊没有给他喘息的机会，雪花大道一卷，数十道霜刃封住曹立左右。

“曹立，你以为打赢几个丹峰长老，就能跟我叫板？”
曹立抬臂扫开霜刃，手臂上又多了几条血痕。“你以为你很厉害？”
白尊脸色一沉，身形再次逼近。
他不愧是圣子。
九品天尊大圆满的修为一压下来，曹立身上的八丈七彩莲都被压得往后缩了几分。
这一掌落下，曹立双臂交叉硬挡。
轰！
曹立脚下石面塌下去一层，肩头旧伤被震开，血顺着衣袍往下淌。
丹峰弟子这次总算敢出声了。
“圣子压住了！”
“差一个大境界，曹立再能打也有极限！”
“圣子可是圣人之下第一人，他凭什么赢？”
白尊一掌压住曹立，另一只手结印，身后雪花大道忽然分裂成六片小型雪纹，从六个方向旋转切来。
曹立抬头看了一眼。“花活挺多。”
他脚下金色大道猛地往外一铺，七彩莲从背后飞出，莲瓣一合，硬挡住三片雪纹。
剩下三片穿过防线，一片割在他腰侧，一片划过肩头，最后一片擦着脖颈飞过。
血珠飞起。
丹峰弟子刚要欢呼，曹立已经冲到了白尊面前。
他居然借着雪纹切开的缝隙，硬生生钻进了白尊的近身范围。
content_en:
Danfeng Mountain was quiet for a moment.
Of the three eighth-level elders who had just besieged Cao Li, one was smashed on the stone steps below, one was stepped on and knocked unconscious, and the other was knocked into the pit.
Bai Zun stood in mid-air, his palms still in the posture of attacking. He actually didn't stop him, not even a single one.
Cao Li slowly turned around and looked at Bai Zun. "It's clean now."
The chill on Bai Zun's body suddenly rose.
The snowflake avenue turned faster and faster behind him, and the surrounding frost crawled out along the gravel. Several Danfeng disciples were frozen to the point of taking more than ten steps back.
Bai Zun stared at Cao Li, his voice changed. "Cao Li!"
Cao Li shook his numb hand. "What are you shouting for? I know you are here."
Bai Zun formed a seal with his hands, and the aura of the Great Perfection of the Ninth-Rank Tianzun was completely released, and a second layer of lines appeared on the Snowflake Avenue.
Lu Chenzhou frowned behind the clouds.
The Holy Lord also looked down.
The next moment, Bai Zun turned into a white shadow and rushed towards Cao Li. "I will suppress you with my own hands!"
Bai Zun turned into a white shadow and pressed forward. The snowflake avenue turned very fast behind him, and the frost layer spread all the way along the mountain road.
Cao Li stood there, raised his hand to wipe the blood from his chin, and grinned. “It’s not yet clear who will suppress whom.”
As soon as he finished speaking, golden light exploded under his feet, and people rushed towards Bai Zun.
Bang!
The two collided head-on.
The avenue of snowflakes cuts down, and the colorful lotus tops up.
As soon as the frost light and the lotus light touched each other, the restrictions in the middle of the Alchemy Peak all lit up, and the outer walls of several alchemy rooms cracked directly. The alchemy disciples ran back holding the alchemy furnace.
Cao Li hit Bai Zun's palm with his fist, and his whole body slid back several feet. Bai Zun didn't give him a chance to breathe. A snowflake avenue rolled up, and dozens of frost blades sealed Cao Li's left and right sides.
"Cao Li, do you think you can challenge me by defeating a few Danfeng elders?"
Cao Li raised his arm to sweep away the frost blade, and there were a few more blood marks on his arm. "You think you're awesome?"
Bai Zun's face darkened and he approached again.
He is truly the Son of God.
As soon as the ninth-grade Tianzun's great perfect cultivation was suppressed, the eight-foot colorful lotus on Cao Li's body was suppressed and shrank back a bit.
When the palm fell, Cao Li crossed his arms to block it.
boom!
The stone beneath Cao Li's feet collapsed, an old wound on his shoulder was opened, and blood flowed down his clothes.
Danfeng disciples finally dared to speak out this time.
"The Holy Son suppressed it!"
"It's a big difference. No matter how hard Cao Li can fight, there will be a limit!"
"The Holy Son is the first person among the saints, why should he win?"
Bai Zun suppressed Cao Li with one palm and formed a seal with the other hand. The snowflake avenue behind him suddenly split into six small snow patterns, rotating and cutting from six directions.
Cao Li looked up. "It's a lot of work."
The golden road under his feet suddenly spread out, and the colorful lotus flew out from behind. The lotus petals closed and blocked three snow patterns.
The remaining three pieces passed through the defense line, one cut on his waist, one crossed his shoulder, and the last one flew past his neck.
Blood beads flew up.
Just as the Danfeng disciples were about to cheer, Cao Li had already rushed in front of Bai Zun.
He actually used the gap cut by the snow pattern to forcefully get into Bai Zun's close range.
